disclosure: This v4 hybrid reuses already-inspected manual-only folds. It combines v3 event detection/localization with v2 monotonic frame-force recovery. The Newton output is approximate, force resolution remains unestablished, and no result is untouched confirmation evidence.

component_selection.force: v2 isotonic signed-range mapping retained after grouped isotonic, ridge, elastic-net, Extra Trees, and histogram-gradient benchmark; the best nested search improved MAE by only about 0.002 N and was unstable across folds
component_selection.localization: v3 accumulated positive active-fraction argmax retained after grouped logistic, shrinkage-LDA, and Extra Trees comparison

force_output.active_event: current approximate frame force when optical score is inside fitted support
force_output.completed_event: maximum approximate in-support force over the event

research_basis.optical_mapping: calibrated optical intensity can encode mechanical loading, but device-specific calibration is required
research_basis.model_constraints: monotonic response is preferred where physical response should not decrease with the optical score
research_basis.runtime: reviewed NumPy/JSON only; no executable pickle

release.known_gate_failure: Force resolution is not established against the session-balanced constant baseline; existing folds are post-hoc; known-force hardware, soak, and usability validation are unavailable.
